verdict.rationale: The axis clearly applies to a source-control and merge-request platform like GitLab, but nothing in the evidence pack documents code owners, path-based ownership, or required approvals from designated owners on merge requests. The nearby items do not qualify: agent-session human-in-the-loop approvals and programmatic user-access control are different features, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can require approval from designated code owners for changes to the paths they own
